_comment: Integrity lockfile for bare-kit prebuilds fetched by scripts/fetch-prebuilds.mjs (issue #55). `version` MUST match the pinned version in fetch-prebuilds.mjs (and the package bump). `artifacts` maps each downloaded release asset name to its expected SHA-256. The script fails closed on a checksum mismatch. When bumping the bare-kit version, delete and re-fetch the artifact, recompute its SHA-256, and update both `version` and the per-artifact hash here. Do NOT commit placeholder/TODO hashes into a release.
